text_blocks.snippet: A negative COVID-19 test result indicates that the test did not detect the presence of the SARS-CoV-2 virus in the sample tested. This does not necessarily mean that the individual is not infected with COVID-19, as the test may have limitations in detecting the virus, especially if the individual has a low viral load or is in the early stages of infection.

list.snippet: The sensitivity of the test used may vary.
The test may not be accurate if the sample is not collected or handled properly.
The individual may have been infected recently and the virus has not yet reached detectable levels.

text_blocks.snippet: If symptoms of COVID-19 develop after a negative test, it is recommended to consult a healthcare professional for further evaluation and testing.
